finding_1_ph_specification_consistency.summary: Re-anchored all pH gating logic to approved Phase 3C.4 baseline. Removed unsupported hard-coded lethal dictionaries (arbitrary 8.8 lethal thresholds). Crops marked SOFT_PENALTY pass Tier 1 at pH 8.6 and 9.0 with WARNING_ONLY and receive soft penalties in Tier 2. Pulses fail at 8.6 due to verified Class A nodulation arrest. Barley and Cotton pass at 9.0 due to CSSRI/FAO-29 salt tolerance. Extreme sodicity (pH 9.2 > 9.0) triggers universal arable crop failure (NO_RECOMMENDATION_SUITABLE) with Gypsum Advisory.

finding_2_prevent_fabricated_stcr_verifi.summary: User-supplied calibration ID, publication title, institution name, coefficient, or 'VALIDATED' string is strictly rejected as proof of calibration validity. Established versioned immutable registry (STCRCalibrationRegistry, v2026.1-OFFICIAL). Rejects unregistered or tampered records back to BASELINE_RDF_ARITHMETIC. Valid registered calibrations produce VERIFIED_STCR_GENERATED with polynomial nutrient doses and 18% DAP nitrogen credit deduction.

finding_3_prevent_fabricated_provenance_.summary: Formalized 6 epistemic provenance tiers (INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED, SOURCE_REFERENCED, USER_DECLARED, ESTIMATED, PROVISIONAL, UNKNOWN). Station IDs and lab accreditation numbers provided by users remain USER_DECLARED. Elevating to INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED strictly requires an authentic TrustedVerificationRecord from a recognized authority (AUTH-ICAR-SHC-REGISTRY, AUTH-IMD-AWS-NETWORK, AUTH-CWC-HYDROLOGY) with matching observation ID, valid date, and verified status.
